## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
In `src/fine_art_archive/eink/palette.py:422-434`, `acuity_blur_radius()` validates inputs with `if ppi <= 0 or viewing_distance_cm <= 0: raise ValueError(...)`. When `ppi` or `viewing_distance_cm` is `float('nan')`, `nan <= 0` evaluates to `False`, bypassing the guard and returning `nan` silently instead of raising `ValueError`.

#### Tasks
- [ ] Add finite number validation to `acuity_blur_radius()` in `src/fine_art_archive/eink/palette.py` checking `math.isfinite(ppi)` and `math.isfinite(viewing_distance_cm)`.
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/test_dither_metric_discriminates.py` asserting `acuity_blur_radius` raises `ValueError` on NaN and infinite inputs.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_dither_metric_discriminates.py` passes with 100% success.
- [ ] Calling `acuity_blur_radius(float("nan"), 50.0)` or `acuity_blur_radius(150.0, float("inf"))` raises `ValueError`.
- [ ] Deliberate break: remove `math.isfinite` check in `src/fine_art_archive/eink/palette.py`, run `pytest tests/test_dither_metric_discriminates.py`, and verify that the NaN parameter test fails; revert to pass.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->
